_doc: Machine-readable manager-principles ownership + inheritance (S0.1, SP-20260530-001). The single source of truth for /scan:manager-principles. Principles are identified by STABLE SLUGS, never ordinals — referring to a principle as 'DoP #7' breaks silently when the list reorders (refactor-hygiene bug class). Model: shared base -> Director -> Lead -> specialist; 'rooted_in' = where a principle is owned, inheritance propagates it down. β EVT-org-roadmap-principles-beta-001 (R4) + FINAL-PLAN §11.A.

clarity-is-king.name: Clarity is King
clarity-is-king.summary: Clear beats clever / witty; message-first. The convergence insight (product 'clarity is king' = an external brand-building methodology's (paid course, not redistributed) 'clarity > cleverness'). A NEW shared-base principle, not a former DoP/DoQA named principle.

map-user-journey.name: Map the User Journey
map-user-journey.summary: Evaluate every decision in the entry->goal->next-step flow, not in isolation; the worst bugs live in the seams between features. Promoted to base — it was the duplicate across DoP #10 and DoQA #7.

evidence-over-invention.name: Evidence over Invention
evidence-over-invention.summary: Ground every call in the real project + real data; if the evidence isn't there, say what you'd need rather than inventing it. Source-attributed, confidence-scored, no fabricated audience psychographics.

claims-boundary.name: Claims Boundary / Source-Grounded Claims
claims-boundary.summary: Marketing owns the market promise (message_brief); Product owns the product-verifiable claim (offer_brief); they must not blur, and security/compliance review stays independent. Crosses Product/Marketing/Research/Compliance — a shared base principle (GPT re-review §11.A).

audience-is-king.name: Audience is King
audience-is-king.note: Rooted on the Director (strategy); the Research/Insight Lead INHERITS it and applies its deepest/emotional-layers form (S2.1 — that Lead agent now exists). Inheritance, not a move — it stays the Director's owned principle so it does not duplicate-own.

ftue-nux.name: First-Time Experience is Sacred (FTUE/NUX)
ftue-nux.note: Execution-tier principle: MOVED to the Product Lead at S2.1 (its natural home, R4) — the Lead agent now exists to carry it. Formerly rooted on the Director of Product (with a moves_to annotation) until this carrier existed.

cold-vs-warm-start.name: Cold Start vs Warm Start
cold-vs-warm-start.note: Execution-tier principle: MOVED to the Product Lead at S2.1 (R4) — the Lead agent now exists to carry it. Formerly rooted on the Director of Product until this carrier existed.

product-priority-over-severity.name: Product Priority over Severity
product-priority-over-severity.note: QA's natural home (DoQA #1). Formerly ALSO carried on DoP as its #7 (removed in S0.1); the DoQA cross-reference now uses this slug, not the DoP ordinal.

golden-first.name: Golden First (by path and by user)

size-testing-scope-depth.name: Size Testing by Scope × Depth, Deliberately

gate-ordered-phases.name: Gate in Ordered Phases; a Blocker Stops the Line

test-real-world.name: Test the Real World, Not the Happy Demo

build-for-audience-incl-limitations.name: Build for the Audience, Including Their Limitations
build-for-audience-incl-limitations.note: Craft-tier (Product Designer): the design expression of the inherited audience-is-king — design for the cohort's concrete limitations (elderly -> bigger/simpler; low tech-literacy -> no jargon), not just an idealized user.

kiss.name: KISS (Keep It Simple)
kiss.note: Craft-tier (Product Designer): the layout/interaction expression of the inherited clarity-is-king — the simplest interface that does the job; subtract before adding.

clear-iconography.name: Clear Iconography & Visual Language
clear-iconography.note: Craft-tier (Product Designer): every icon/label/state reads unambiguously to the target audience; consistent visual language (pairs with the design-quality gauntlet's component-usage + visual-hierarchy checks).

no-invented-data.name: No Invented Data
no-invented-data.note: Research-craft-tier: the sharpening of the inherited evidence-over-invention at the audience-research altitude — never fabricate psychographics/quotes/metrics; synthetic extrapolations are labelled synthetic:true, never presented as observed.

confidence-scored.name: Confidence-Scored
confidence-scored.note: Research-craft-tier: every claim + dossier carries a 0-1 confidence; low confidence is a first-class result, never rounded up (audience_dossier.confidence).

no-pii.name: No PII (segment-level only)
no-pii.note: Research-craft-tier: dossiers are segment-level with no personally-identifiable info (pii_free:true) — the line between audience research and surveillance (FINAL-PLAN anti-surveillance guardrail).

copy-over-creative.name: Copy over Creative
copy-over-creative.note: Marketing domain (S2.2): copy is the foundation, creative carries it; the deliverable is a winning MESSAGE (transmutable across formats), not a winning ad. 'Ugly ads = pretty profits.'

message-first.name: Message-First
message-first.note: Marketing domain (S2.2): everything derives from one winning message built on contrast + 5-layer depth (thought->emotion->belief->identity->consciousness). The message_brief is the spine; the market_promise stays inside the claims-boundary. The Marketing application of inherited clarity-is-king — NOT a second clarity slug (dedup pass §11.A).

eq-scoring.name: EQ Scoring -> SCALE/TEST/SKIP
eq-scoring.note: Growth execution-tier: EQ = Product x Ads x Funnel x LTV (1-10 each + justification); 9-10 SCALE, 5-7 TEST, <5 SKIP. Skeptical/decisive; missing live data => downgrade, never certify SCALE; unverifiable => ASSUMPTION.

money-loves-speed.name: Money Loves Speed
money-loves-speed.note: Growth execution-tier: the tightest feedback loop wins; assume nothing, only data is real; fan out the WINNER (not guesses) via growth:iterate / karpathy:run.

ltv-cac.name: LTV:CAC >= 3
ltv-cac.note: Growth execution-tier: judge Ads + Funnel + back-end LTV; target >=3:1 (high-ticket 7-10:1); margin math shown not asserted; the funnel is a force multiplier on every creative.

argument-not-copy.name: Argument, Not Copy (Agora/E5)
argument-not-copy.note: Copy execution-tier: persuade by the magnificence of the argument, not the words; lead to one North-Star belief; introduce + prove a unique mechanism; marketing = belief-change work (install/remove beliefs first); verbs layered later in editing.

hooks-are-90.name: Hooks Are 90%
hooks-are-90.note: Copy execution-tier: the hook is ~90% of the effort (PIG / scroll-stopper test), grounded in real voice-of-customer; mine the philosophy/framework, not the literal copy.

chief-coherence.name: Chief Coherence
chief-coherence.note: Copy execution-tier: owns the editor-in-chief pass — copy vs avatar/proof/beliefs/levels-of-consciousness/objections + chiefing discipline (read-aloud greased-slide, grade <=8, <=6 'I believe that…' beliefs, no decorative images, correct caps). Fails => not done. The named gate behind the chief-coherence enforcer.

conversion-hierarchy.name: Conversion Hierarchy
conversion-hierarchy.note: Web craft-tier: one job + one obvious CTA; hook->proof->CTA flow; mobile-first; every element installs a belief / removes an objection; respects the ad->lander->offer journey. Defers formal token/accessibility/handoff approval to the design-quality gauntlet. The conversion-specific application of inherited clarity-is-king — NOT a second clarity slug.

contract-first-construction.name: Contract-First Construction
contract-first-construction.summary: What gets built derives from a contract (the build_spec, highest precedence, realizing the design_brief), not from vibes; contracts declare precedence so per-domain gauntlets can't deadlock. A build_spec naming a component with no ui/ source is a contract defect, not a license to hand-roll.

enforcer-over-checklist.name: Enforcer over Checklist
enforcer-over-checklist.summary: Every engineering rule names what makes a violation self-detecting (hook/scan/test/gate that exits non-zero); enforcers must REJECT not lint and fail closed (runner-error -> non-zero, malformed -> fail-closed). The engineering application of CLAUDE.md Policy & Enforcement Hygiene.

fe-be-separation-of-concerns.name: Frontend/Backend Separation of Concerns
fe-be-separation-of-concerns.summary: FE builds the user-facing surface (components/design adherence/a11y/responsive); BE builds the truth behind it (APIs/data/auth/validation/integration). Split by concern; do NOT 2x every concern — shared builder discipline lives once in the build-core. Start with FE+BE; add Foundation/Integration only on proven shared-file pain.

own-the-integration-seam.name: Own the Integration Seam
own-the-integration-seam.summary: The FE/BE seam (generated types, shared lib files, env, data contracts) is where the worst bugs live — map-user-journey applied to code. Name the seam owner before the build (the Gamma integration phase, S1.3), not after the pilot finds the pain. Producer defines the shape; consumer adapts.

refactor-hygiene.name: Refactor & Rename Hygiene
refactor-hygiene.summary: A shared-identifier change or file delete is a whole-codebase event: grep the OLD literal / basename everywhere before completing it (the file you forget is the bug class). A lib-only fix doesn't protect callers that bypass the lib — pair every transport fix with a write-time guard + a contract rule. The engineering rooting of CLAUDE.md Refactor & Rename Hygiene.

build-disposable-spec-durable.name: Build Disposable, Spec Durable
build-disposable-spec-durable.summary: Code is the cheap regenerable output; the spec/contract/enforcer is the durable asset (the Dark Factory model). Favor sharpening the build_spec/check over polishing code a regen replaces. Build over buy for anything core; the bar to add a dependency is high and a hallucinated dep is a supply-chain risk the gauntlet rejects.
